notes.title: Celebrate the Holidays with There’s No Santa – FREE Hidden-Object Fun!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44371394/11e8f1eae2bd5e797cfa70b43f1420e42b2699f7.png

We have an exciting festive surprise for you! 🎁 If you love immersive, colorful gameplay, try There’s No Santa, a cozy hidden-object game perfect for the holiday season.

🌟 Why you’ll love it:

 4 festive, hand-drawn locations filled with Christmas magic 🎄
 A randomized pool of 60 objects – new challenges every play! 🔍
 3 difficulty levels to match your play style 🔧
 Achievements and features like zoom and hints for added fun 🏆

And it’s completely FREE! Don’t miss this chance to enjoy the perfect holiday gaming experience. 🎮

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192350/Theres_No_Santa

Bonus! 🌈
Relax even more with Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number - it's also FREE, including the achievements. 🏆 Bring over 100 pixel images to life in your preferred style – classic color-by-number or textured cross-stitching. It’s the ultimate combination of creativity and relaxation!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071670/Pixel_Cross_Stitch_Color_by_Number/
